meta_description:
13K likes, 236 comments - foodpharmer on October 29, 2026: "Yeast Protein Cocoa is finally HERE!

But why did we launch yeast protein when plant and whey protein already exist?

The reason we launched yeast protein is that it is more affordable than whey.

And it could also be a good alternative for those who don’t enjoy the taste of plant protein!

We’ve kept the ingredient list simple: 

1. Yeast protein isolate
2. Cocoa 
3. Stevia 

That’s it! No unnecessary fillers, no added colours, and no fancy claims like “gut-friendly” to influence you to buy something you don’t need.

We always say, don’t trust us, test us!

Yeast Protein Cocoa is now available on the Only What’s Needed app and website. (Link in bio!)

Let’s Make India Protein Sufficient!".
